hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(rm -rf /|rm -rf \.|--force.*origin.*main|git push.*--force|docker system prune.*--all.*--force|DROP DATABASE|DROP TABLE)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Dangerous command detected. Please review and confirm before running destructive operations.' && exit 2; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '(\.env$|\.env\.production|\.env\.local|credentials\.json|secrets\.|.*\.pem$|.*\.key$)'; then echo 'WARNING: Editing sensitive file. Ensure no secrets are hardcoded.' >&2; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$'; then for file in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do if [ -f "$file" ]; then npx prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(go)$'; then for file in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do if [ -f "$file" ]; then gofmt -w "$file" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(py)$'; then for file in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do if [ -f "$file" ]; then ruff format "$file" 2>/dev/null || black "$file" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(json)$'; then for file in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do if [ -f "$file" ]; then npx prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; fi
